name: Shinozawa Mai
source:
She works part time as a miko at a shrine that is famous for being a place to pray for successful relationships.
A second year high school student who was raised in a normal family.
A bright girl who is kind and pure, she does everything whole-heartedly.
She admires her parents loving relationship and hopes someday to have a marriage like that.
